title: Drug Sensitivity Correlation Between Patient-Derived Organoid Model and Clinical Response in NSCLC Patients
brief_summary: This clinical study aims to evaluate the feasibility to predict clinical response of target therapy or chemotherapy drugs based on the ex vivo drug sensitivity data using patient-derived organoids.
study_population: Metastatic NSCLC patients with axillary and other region lymph nodes metastasis. The biopsy and/or surgery tissue samples of metastatic and/or primitive tumor are accessible.
